rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: Milwaukee-based WEC Energy Group is a leading U.S. utility company providing regulated electricity and natural gas, as well as renewable and nonregulated energy services through subsidiaries across Wisconsin, Illinois, Michigan, and Minnesota. The company operates a diverse generation portfolio including coal, natural gas, nuclear, oil, wind, solar, hydroelectric, and biomass. It is actively investing in renewable energy and grid modernization, with plans to invest $9.1 billion through 2029 to expand solar, wind, and energy storage capacity. WEC Infrastructure owns a fleet of renewable generation facilities in states from South Dakota to Texas. WEC was founded as the Wisconsin Energy Corp. in 1896.
